name: n4_read_tags
description: Read the tags of one or more components (ord, or ords: up to 50). Per component: direct tags (metadata slots, as {id, namespace, name, type, value, slot, flags}; the slot name is the escaped id, hs:point is hs$3apoint), tag_groups (each an n:tagGroup relation to a group definition, {group_ord, slot}), direct relations ({id, endpoint_ord, inbound, slot}) and, unless implied is false, the implied tags the station's dictionaries compute ({id, type, value}; a tag group's tags appear here). relations: direct (default), all (adds the implied relations, such as n:parent and n:child) or none. One load per component, plus one session call each for implied tags and implied relations.

ords.description: Several component ORDs (1 to 50), read in order

implied.description: Also read the implied tags (default true)

relations.description: direct (default): the relation slots on the component; all: also the implied relations; none: no relations
